name: Pro Life Update
subject: Shepherd - Father - King
body:
While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don't know his full story

| This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zhqq8umd96m36gqlbupick7rek2l3811q8idod68_rp22sh2s8i66o70chjm0ob6cjh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don't know his full story--especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David's momentous story provides profound insights into many of life's most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **" The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King"** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David's character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we 've produced our online course, "The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King," which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2znb6ttp6n05qdsv8in8837lvvlboedqvddeko4gg_rp22sh2s8i66o70chjm0ob6cjh2bs)** By viewing the course, you'll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you'll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you 'll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---

---

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

Hillsdale College

subject: Protect Your Finances and Freedom from Biden's Digital Dollar
body:
The 'Digital Dollar' is now a reality.

|
---
# **Financial Freedom in America**

| | | Fellow American, I'm sure you've seen it in the national news, but I'd like to reiterate: There is serious hostility towards the founding principles of liberty on too many college campuses. Many college students are not taught the true meaning of terms like "Freedom" and "Equality." They are accepting false promises of free college and health care and voting for candidates who wish to embrace that fantasy. This is evidenced by recent polling data, which shows that 70% of Millennials say they are likely to vote socialist. Worst of all, many students on college campuses refuse to engage with those whom they disagree--instead, they resort to intimidation, threats, and rioting in a manner that incites violence. I'm curious to know what you think about the state of higher education in America. If you have a few minutes, I'd love to ask you a few questions about America's education system, and whether the damage to it can be repaired. name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Growing up poor, this country took a chance on me. Now I am asking for you to take a chance on this campaign.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friends –
The things I want in life are not exotic. I think most people feel the same way.
I want loving relationships with my family. I want to help my constituents, and I want an America that lives up to its ideals.
Growing up poor, this country took a chance on me.
I took advantage of the things Democrats championed and the people of our country provided: Pell Grants and school lunch programs, to name just two.
Those helping hands gave me (and people like me) a debt of gratitude I worked to pay back through service — first in the Marines, and now in Congress.
The truth is, Senator Sinema has been an advocate for the rich and powerful in the Senate.
But those folks have enough advocates there.
It’s the people deciding between groceries and utilities who need help.
That’s why I am running.
But if we’re going to win this race, it is going to take a historic grassroots effort. And this week’s FEC deadline is such a critical marker in our journey.
I couldn’t get to where I am in life without help. And I can’t win this race either. It’s going to take all of us to win. So I am asking:
Can I count on you to split $20 between Serve America and our Senate campaign before our first FEC fundraising deadline comes to a close tomorrow? I would not be asking if it was not so terribly important. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]Thank you,
Ruben

body:

Hillsdale College

Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey
on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWHlSOHDNY

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

In an interview published in Imprimis,
Hillsdale's digest of liberty, Associate Justice of the Supreme
Court Clarence Thomas explained what he sees as his role on the
nation's highest court: "My job is to apply the Constitution."

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper
role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution
instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your National
Survey on the United States Supreme Court using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61650940:WHlSOHDNY:m:3:2532013465:E41716BD2F9EA3FF1F20FC62BD319FD2:r

Thank you for your time and
attention-and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty
since 1844

49242 USA

After a long hibernation, a weak mama bear and her tiny cubs emerge from their den into the warm air. White flowers scatter the forest floor as the cubs glimpse their first spring. But in the blink of an eye, _**those flowers could be splattered red with their blood**_ as they’re gunned down by the hunters they didn’t notice lurking in the trees. [**These baby bear cubs’ lives have barely started: protect their futures and the planet by donating $27 immediately to help us reach our $3,760 goal before midnight tonight!**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1696183?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
America’s bears are under attack, Friend. Trophy hunters are gunning them down. Big Oil wants to open their habitats to logging and mining -- all for the sake of profit. **And it’s all perfectly legal.**
**The Biden Administration took steps to lift federal protections for grizzlies in the Northern Rockies,** which would put grizzlies back in the crosshairs of trophy hunting after years of steady recovery. We can’t let this happen -- but we’re facing intense pushback from greedy trophy hunting and Big Oil lobbies, so bears need your help now more than ever!
**Don’t let trophy hunters and greedy corporations wipe out grizzly bears. Donate $27 right now and help us reach our $3,760 goal for bears and the planet.**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

---
In the coming months, hunters could kill a mother bear who emerges from hibernation. She may be looking to replenish her lethargic and underfed body to give her the strength to care for her cubs.
Bear cubs rely on their mothers until they reach 17 months old -- without them, cubs don’t stand a chance of survival as **they are left to suffer from starvation, predation, and exposure.**
But states in the northern Rockies are still working to remove Endangered Species Act protections for these bears. This would allow trophy hunters to stalk the bears, wait until they leave the safety of their dens, and trap them with **painful metal clamps.** Or they could release hunting dogs to**track and terrorize bears** before they are killed.
This rollback of protections for grizzlies is an ominous sign for the future of America’s endangered wildlife and the entire web of life it supports. As Endangered Species Act protections are eroded, we not only risk losing irreplaceable animals -- we lose leverage to stop Big Oil from polluting communities, driving climate chaos, and harming biodiversity across the country.
Special interests and GOP legislators want to roll back the Endangered Species Act and the protections it provides -- **_because they know the law stands in their way from drilling, fracking, mining, and clear-cutting public lands._**
**Protect bear families and the planet before it’s too late: Rush your $27 donation to Friends of the Earth now!**

---
Grizzly bears are one of the nation’s most cherished and beloved animals. These charismatic creatures are highly intelligent and have been proven to show emotions, including empathy, fear, joy, and pain. They form strong communities with tight family bonds -- mama bears, specifically, are known for being protective and nurturing.
At their peak, grizzlies in the continental U.S. numbered at 50,000! But by 1975, reckless human activity, like hunting, trapping, and habitat loss, decimated their numbers -- prompting their Endangered Species Act protection. Now,_**grizzly populations stand at less than 3,000 in the continental United States.**_
Friend, we’re running out of time to stop grizzlies from being wiped out -- but your membership gift today could help protect them and our planet. Private trophy-hunting interests and Big Polluters are mobilizing resources to gut the ESA, and we need to step up our efforts before it’s too late. Will you donate $27 or more today?
**Act now to stop Big Oil and trophy hunters from wiping out bears and destroying the planet. Donate $27 or more before midnight and help us reach our $3,760 goal!**

#### **Solidarity Strategies named creative agency of the year!**
---
|
---
|

| Greetings from Vegas!
What a night! It is clear that 2023 is a winning year for Solidarity Strategies. We are proud to announce that we have won 10 awards from the 2023 Campaigns and Elections Reed Awards!
* Best Online Video for Statewide- Mi Poder
* Best Spanish Language Online Video- “Juntos for Our Community”
* Best Spanish Language Direct Mail Piece- Florida Rising “El Chavo” mailer
* Best Newspaper Ad for Public Affairs/ Issue Advocacy - LCV Monuments Campaign
* Best OTT/ CTV ad for IE - Jobs (Way to Win)
* Best Direct Mail Piece- NM-02 Gabe Vazquez
* Best Radio Ad for Statewide- Unidos Action PAC - Adrian Fontes
* Best Radio Ad for US House/Senate - Teresa Leger for U.S. Congress
* Best Radio Ad- BBT- Accessible Internet

Notably, we also won**best creative agency of the year**. Yes, you read that correctly! We are the FIRST minority-owned firm to win overall best creative agency of the year!!! Additionally, we made 23 ads that landed as finalists for the 2023 Reed Awards! That’s the most ads we have ever represented as Reed's finalists. Thank you to all of our clients and friends who believed in our small yet mighty Latino firm — we’re honored to be the BEST CREATIVE AGENCY IN THE COUNTRY! As always, thank you for supporting Black and Brown consultants.
-Solidarity Strategies

name: Becky Wagner
subject: My husband is facing 10 years in prison for defending himself
body:
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...

Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5l4lspmlp578qurhjfbra31tv00n24on3o0vor8_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieap77c9h2bs)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. [**That 's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zs3ueoq2aelk64a2d9d00lih1449p0c1c3n39sgg_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieap77c9h2bs)
But first, let me explain what happened...
On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.
Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.
Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.
Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out.
With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up.
Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward.** **
**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**
Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat.
Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark.
Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.
And on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. **Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison.**
[**_Now I hope you can see why I 'm turning to you for help today._**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zok5c27isjpue8oqalkbdk89scacme6d9qt8i8po_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieap77c9h2bs)
Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD).
We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from **the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF)** offering to help Mark.
This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.
Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.
In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help.
They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge!
But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it.
This is why I reached out to you today. I needed to ask you a very important question:
[**_Will you please help my husband Mark fight the unjust charges against him and clear his name by rushing a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF today?_**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zthmtm78b2nchgohu6ikdqasenc0tft61ch97ego_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieap77c9h2bs)
Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family.
Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend 10 YEARS behind bars away from his family.
Right now, LELDF is preparing to ramp up legal action in Mark's case. [**So please follow this link to make your tax-deductible donation right away.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7h1u576k8ann61dbc9uerq2iamjlouumrqrf3bg_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieap77c9h2bs)
Any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. No matter what you're able to give, please say a prayer for Mark and our family.
Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF.
With deepest gratitude,
Becky Wagner
P.S. Mark is the type of person who'd offer to donate a kidney to a friend in need just because it's the right thing to do. In fact, that's exactly what he did when he donated one of his kidneys to his former partner of more than a decade! Mark didn't even let his partner know he got checked out as a potential donor. He just said that his partner had young kids who needed him to be around and it was the right thing to do.
This is the type of man the anti-police mob is targeting and trying to destroy: a kidney donor, a youth football coach, a man who assists the elderly from our parish in running errands and doing handy-man projects. A man of faith who's always helping others.
Mark faces 10 years behind bars - simply for doing his job to serve and protect. [**_Will you help him clear his name by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today?_** ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z140dcraeb6m2hojde8r813a9t8g5iji0vivj9dg_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieap77c9h2bs) Your generosity will help LELDF mount the strongest legal defenses for my husband and other wrongly accused officers. Thank you in advance for your prayers and support.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_
_(C) Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | www.PoliceDefense.org
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303_

ICYMI News

name: Becky Wagner
subject: My husband is facing 10 years in prison for defending himself
body:
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...

Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z12b6p8jj31i9dmfjfk19e3b2h0s116rno6rqjm0_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieaor4cjh2bs)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. [**That 's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zj5sg09noek68tr7nm9vea07lva0i3q77n3ft5h8_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieaor4cjh2bs)
But first, let me explain what happened...
On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.
Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.
Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.
Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out.
With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up.
Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward.** **
**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**
Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat.
Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark.
Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.
And on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. **Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison.**
[**_Now I hope you can see why I 'm turning to you for help today._**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdmeghfgsj7l1l39glmai3biscjblfahs834g1mo_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieaor4cjh2bs)
Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD).
We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from **the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF)** offering to help Mark.
This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.
Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.
In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help.
They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge!
But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it.
This is why I reached out to you today. I needed to ask you a very important question:
[**_Will you please help my husband Mark fight the unjust charges against him and clear his name by rushing a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF today?_**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsug7dckdrt7rcgrf5iobhso2ea6nkv30c8kc22o_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieaor4cjh2bs)
Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family.
Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend 10 YEARS behind bars away from his family.
Right now, LELDF is preparing to ramp up legal action in Mark's case. [**So please follow this link to make your tax-deductible donation right away.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlpa57a51js38698m58g69h15fku8vtg0vlg89g8_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieaor4cjh2bs)
Any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. No matter what you're able to give, please say a prayer for Mark and our family.
Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF.
With deepest gratitude,
Becky Wagner
P.S. Mark is the type of person who'd offer to donate a kidney to a friend in need just because it's the right thing to do. In fact, that's exactly what he did when he donated one of his kidneys to his former partner of more than a decade! Mark didn't even let his partner know he got checked out as a potential donor. He just said that his partner had young kids who needed him to be around and it was the right thing to do.
This is the type of man the anti-police mob is targeting and trying to destroy: a kidney donor, a youth football coach, a man who assists the elderly from our parish in running errands and doing handy-man projects. A man of faith who's always helping others.
Mark faces 10 years behind bars - simply for doing his job to serve and protect. [**_Will you help him clear his name by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today?_** ](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbbr8a45v200a7ep035n3g4c0tr7bgil45f46b68_rp22sh2s8i66o70chieaor4cjh2bs) Your generosity will help LELDF mount the strongest legal defenses for my husband and other wrongly accused officers. Thank you in advance for your prayers and support.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_
_(C) Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | www.PoliceDefense.org
2560 Huntington Ave. Suite 203, Alexandria, VA, 22303_

American Briefing

body:
Our first public filing deadline is just 1 day away. Will you take 60 seconds to listen to why it’s so important?

|
I need your help, Fellow American.

The first public deadline of my campaign is just 1 day away. We have to blow everyone away with the number of grassroots donations our team has secured since launching last month.

To explain how important this first filing deadline is, I recorded a short video for you. **[Will you take 60 seconds to watch it?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2znfvh4ulei00vf6ov3ra2u2miglojh50pltklg2o_rp22sh2s8i66o70chie6p70cdh2bs)**

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr6blaluq0o7smut2ihkdng5l0ugg3tobg08e318_rp22sh2s8i66o70chie6p70cdh2bs)
I am not focused on the amount of your donation. I am looking for lots of donations from conservatives all over America to show that this campaign is a grassroots uprising, built by people like you - not the Washington elite.

**[Before midnight on Friday, I am personally asking for you to chip in ANY amount- whether it’s $1, $5, or even $24. Every little bit helps to advance the agenda in this country.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zplusegsughk8eult89ksbibvmgg7o4r012ton18_rp22sh2s8i66o70chie6p70cdh2bs)**

We are **leading** this race with actual *solutions.* I will do what the other GOP candidates appear afraid to even say. But, I need your help to amplify our ideas and message.

Thanks for joining me,

Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** WATCH NOW -> **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zcf3v97celmshhcpv0ug2cooclj4ovck8ood9j0g_rp22sh2s8i66o70chie6p70cdh2bs)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhe5jfp2j2r3f5ichvq3rhlr7oagtghuqsfnr2b0_rp22sh2s8i66o70chie6p70cdh2bs)

subject: Democrats prioritize special interest donors
body:
The biggest beneficiaries of the Democrats' record-breaking spending spree are the state employee and public sector unions which will receive hefty pay raises - and then the unions will put big money back into Democrat campaign accounts. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61652247:Wge7RHDoN:m:1:2610672541:B8F36364799A8AA219840695CCE340C3:r "Shift Washington")
---
|
Friends,

You've seen the headlines, and the real story is even worse. Democrats in Olympia are on a spending binge, rewarding their special interest group supporters with your taxpayer dollars.

The Democrat-controlled State Senate just passed their own $70 billion spending bill -a budget that mean state spending has doubled in just the last 10 years. **And the biggest beneficiaries of their record-breaking spending spree are the state employee and public sector unions which will receive hefty pay raises - and then the unions will put big money back into Democrat campaign accounts.**

Meanwhile, taxpayers like you and your neighbors are left with the bill despite economic uncertainty and sky-high inflation already delivering a blow to your pocketbooks.

The majority of states across the nation - including such far-Left outposts as New York and California - have passed bills refunding taxpayers some of what they have overpaid to their state following the COVID-19 pandemic, using all the federal money sent to states to help out their citizens. But not in Washington State, under Jay Inslee and Democrat majorities in the legislature. **All we are getting are new taxes.**

Over the last couple of years, the liberals have burdened us with more taxes and refused to lift any existing burdens in the form of even modest tax breaks. Here are just a few ways they could have helped us this legislative session, all of which have been proposed:

* Reduce the regressive sales tax
* Ease the burdensome property tax
* Repeal the unconstitutional state income tax on capital gains
* Suspend the excessive state gas tax (third highest in the nation)
* Repeal the oppressive cap-and-tax scheme
* Abolish the unjust death tax
* Adjust the destructive business and occupation tax

But - of course - Democrats won't do any of those common-sense things in the face of massive budget surpluses. They have to reward their special-interest campaign donors after all.

Unfortunately, what remains of mainstream media outlets refuse to hold Democrats accountable for their record-breaking spending spree. In fact, they are just cheering Democrats on. **That 's why our work here at Shift WA is so important.**

[ **Will you consider helping us continue our efforts with an end-of-month contribution of $100, $50, or even $25 today?**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61652248:Wge7RHDoN:m:1:2610672541:B8F36364799A8AA219840695CCE340C3:r)

[ **We are behind on our goal - and your contribution will go a long way to helping us continue keeping an eye on Olympia as this current session is winding down and reporting back to you. **](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61652248:Wge7RHDoN:m:1:2610672541:B8F36364799A8AA219840695CCE340C3:r)

Thank you,

The Shift WA team | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/61652249:Wge7RHDoN:m:1:2610672541:B8F36364799A8AA219840695CCE340C3:r)

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: My trip to McAllen, Texas
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
What the tragedy this week in Juárez and my recent trip to the southern border has made clear
#
The tragic fire that broke out at a migrant detention center in Ciudad Juárez and claimed 38 lives has shaken and infuriated me, Peter.
The victims had traveled from Central and South America to seek asylum in the United States, but were detained as a result of the decades of extreme militarization at our southern border. **Xenophobic fear mongering, and outright lies by the GOP about an “invasion” at the U.S/Mexico border has directly contributed to these inhumane policies.**
This has to stop, Peter.
As a ranking member of the House Immigration Subcommittee, I intend to do everything in my power to reform our broken immigration system and better serve those who come to our country looking for refuge. [**Can you support me and our movement in this fight by chipping in $3 today? Your contribution will help us continue to debunk the false narratives that the GOP and subcommittee Chair Jim Jordan are continuing to spin.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16153?c0=20230330.6rhp5P&refcode=em20230330-2320&t=1&akid=2320%2E420207%2EH5iCVy)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16153?c0=20230330.6rhp5P&refcode=em20230330-2320&t=20&akid=2320%2E420207%2EH5iCVy)**
This month I joined a Congressional delegation trip to the southern border in McAllen, Texas to meet with local officials and humanitarian leaders. What I saw there wasn’t at all the chaotic, terror-filled picture that the right-wing has painted, but a thriving community with a rich bi-national history.
**This trip, and the tragedy in Juárez, has put into clear focus something we already knew to be true: our immigration system is in desperate need of reform with real legal pathways for migrants who are fleeing terrible situations or want to be reunited with family.** Pathways which are accessible and reasonable without onerous hurdles to overcome.
[I am ready to keep up the fight for anyone who is willing to risk a journey of thousands of miles to seek sanctuary, Peter. Will you join me and help in this effort by contributing $3 today?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16153?c0=20230330.6rhp5P&refcode=em20230330-2320&t=21&akid=2320%2E420207%2EH5iCVy)
Asylum seekers deserve dignity, safety, and more than a promise of a better tomorrow. They deserve humanity today, right now.
In the fight,
Pramila

name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: First public filing deadline
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek 2024
body:
Our first public filing deadline is just 1 day away. Will you take 60 seconds to listen to why it’s so important?

|
I need your help, Fellow American.

The first public deadline of my campaign is just 1 day away. We have to blow everyone away with the number of grassroots donations our team has secured since launching last month.

To explain how important this first filing deadline is, I recorded a short video for you. **[Will you take 60 seconds to watch it?](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c03032%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=h4wJ75AS5bDMkBD01aNlqQ&sysid=1)**

[](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c03033%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KrCmMAeKoRU96NRSHxyrMA&sysid=1)
I am not focused on the amount of your donation. I am looking for lots of donations from conservatives all over America to show that this campaign is a grassroots uprising, built by people like you - not the Washington elite.

**[Before midnight on Friday, I am personally asking for you to chip in ANY amount- whether it’s $1, $5, or even $24. Every little bit helps to advance the agenda in this country.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c03034%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wNEDIIU%2byVVhE7qr0zU8gw&sysid=1)**

We are **leading** this race with actual *solutions.* I will do what the other GOP candidates appear afraid to even say. But, I need your help to amplify our ideas and message.

Thanks for joining me,

Vivek Ramaswamy

| [** WATCH NOW → **](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c03045%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PzPiT2FZLaq%2bDpmqyU2iOQ&sysid=1)
---

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

[ ** STAND WITH VIVEK ➞ **](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c03046%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bLM2blGa52qsqHe4Wq6lVQ&sysid=1)

Not even 12 hours went by after the tragic school shooting in Nashville, in which a Christian school was deliberately targeted by a transgender shooter, when Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs' Press Secretary used a gif of Gina Rowlands from the movie Gloria to describe what she would do to "transphobes."
The AZFC was the first to bring attention to this disgusting tweet and immediately called for the governor's press secretary to be fired.

This brought the caucus several appearances in national media, including a mention on Fox & Friends.
[State Freedom Caucus Network @SFC_NetworkGov. Katie Hobbs' press secretary just resigned after she called for shooting people Democrats disagree with less than 12 hours after a targeted attack against a Christian school in Nashville. The @AZFreedomCaucus was at the forefront of bringing attention to this disgusting act ](https://substack.com/redirect/d68fa955-4b98-4953-be0d-fdc36758e1ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)[4:58 PM ∙ Mar 29, 2023
* * *
213Likes66Retweets](https://substack.com/redirect/d68fa955-4b98-4953-be0d-fdc36758e1ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Naturally, Hobbs didn't fire her press secretary for this disgusting tweet but instead allowed her to resign on her own. That should tell you everything you need to know about this governor.
The AZFC will ensure that her disgusting woke agenda is dead on arrival.

**Andy Roth**

Friends,
One thing you may know about my story is that I am a refugee.
When I was just a young child, my family was forced to escape civil war in Somalia, and we took sanctuary in a Kenyan refugee camp for four years.
We didn't always have food, or running water. But we did always hold out hope that one day, we would be able to get out of that camp and start a new life in the United States.
At the time, I never could have even _imagined_ I would someday run for office — nevermind become the first African-born member of Congress, or that tens of thousands of people across the country would be with me along the way.
I wouldn't have believed you if you told me. No way.
Each and every thing that our campaigns and our work in Congress has accomplished has only ever been possible because of people like you, and I want you to know that I am incredibly grateful to have your trust and support.
Every day I count my blessings — but the fact is, we still have a lot of work to do.
If our movement is going to continue building progressive power and fighting for the values and issues we believe in, it's going to take every single one of us standing together. That means I have to ask, especially today:

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: A big announcement from me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I’ve made it official and I wanted you to hear it from me: I’m running for re-election to the U.S. Senate next year.
Together, we’ve won some big battles for working families across the country. But there’s plenty more to do. So I’m staying in the fight. And I’m asking if you’ll be a part of this new campaign from the start:
[Can you split a donation right now to support my re-election campaign and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez? I’d be deeply grateful to have your support as I take on this new righteous fight alongside her in Congress.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230330-1.twRnDa&refcode=em20230330-4062-P_FND_SPL_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4062%2E2526796%2Eb-lFg2)
**[Contribute $6](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230330-1.twRnDa&refcode=em20230330-4062-P_FND_SPL_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=4062%2E2526796%2Eb-lFg2)**
I first ran for Senate because I saw how the system is rigged for the wealthy and well-connected and against everyone else.
I won because Massachusetts voters know it too. And even though we’ve been up against powerful forces, the past ten years have shown us that when we organize, fight righteous fights, and hold those in power accountable, we can make positive change, including:
* Getting student loan debt cancelation to President Biden’s desk
* Passing a new tax on massive corporate profits
* Lowering the cost of hearing aids
* Pressuring Wells Fargo executives into resigning after their fake accounts scandal
* Even making billionaires cry on national TV

Now I’m running for re-election because there’s a lot more we’ve got to do. Pass a wealth tax. Make child care affordable. Ensure the right to an abortion. Protect consumers from big banks. Make our government work for everyone, not just a thin slice at the top.
**We’re going to build this new campaign the same way we’ve built all our campaigns: from the grassroots level. Because with a grassroots-funded movement, we can fight back against extremist Republicans and powerful interests who use their deep pockets to try to block change.****
****
**I’m proud to have partnered with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez as we’ve fought for working families, meaningful action on the climate crisis, and holding Wall Street accountable. And I’m looking forward to continuing our work together for environmental, social, racial, and economic justice.
[Please make a contribution to support Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and my re-election campaign today, if you can. Every contribution, no matter how big or small, adds up and helps show that there’s strong support for our plans and our values. Side by side, let’s rebuild the middle class, root corruption out of our government, and strengthen our democracy.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230330-1.twRnDa&refcode=em20230330-4062-P_FND_SPL_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=4062%2E2526796%2Eb-lFg2)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20230330-1?refcode=em20230330-4062-P_FND_SPL_GFM&t=22&refcode2=4062_2526796_b-lFg2&akid=4062%2E2526796%2Eb-lFg2)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20230330-4062-P_FND_SPL_GFM&t=23&akid=4062%2E2526796%2Eb-lFg2)**

"**Republican New York Rep. Claudia Tenney will introduce the 'End Zuckerbucks Act'**.

_**[Join My Fight for Election Integrity: RUSH IN>>>](https://click.email.claudiatenneyforcongress.com/?qs=ca414f6629673f35eb38e00cb851a8e09d7bbff1320ce4c2a10b766fcae29366056fec96b16cf61f1d4a39733c44f77bbc18f81e0a2ab6ca "Join Claudia’s Fight for Election Integrity: RUSH IN >>>")**_
---

Happy Women’s History Month, Derek!
My name is Katherine Clark, and I proudly serve Massachusetts’ 5th district in Congress. I am also in House leadership serving as the Democratic Whip.
When I first came to Congress in 2013, there weren’t many women serving alongside me. Multiple times, I was stopped and mistaken for someone’s spouse, and I had a hard time even getting into the Chamber.
Thankfully, walking through the halls of Congress in 2023 is much different. **There are more women serving in Congress than ever before — 94 women in the House Democratic Caucus alone!**
I’ve been adamant about helping elect more women to Congress, because the truth is that for generations, we’ve failed to address the persistent challenges faced by women, especially by women of color.
**And with MAGA extremists in the House majority threatening to take us back even further, the stakes of our work couldn’t be higher.**

Friends –
My reelection campaign is up and running, and I need your help to make sure this seat is not in play for Republicans in 2024. Our Senate majority is incredibly slim, and the truth is the map is even tougher for us than it was last year.
The experts at Cook Political say Democrats are “almost entirely on defense” because there really aren’t any seats we can flip blue. That means holding every single seat is going to be that much more important.
So I’m not willing to take anything for granted. There’s a real danger if any of our opponents think we’re asleep at the wheel and vulnerable to negative ads.
Last time I was up for reelection, Republicans pumped millions of dollars into Connecticut to try to make gains in our state. We saw the same thing last cycle when Republicans dumped huge amounts of money trying to pick up Senate seats in reliably blue states like Washington and Colorado.
And frankly, the reason we didn’t hold the House last year is because Republicans made significant inroads in New York.
That’s why it’s so important that we demonstrate we are ready for anything that comes our way – whether from Mitch McConnell’s super PACs, the gun lobby or another self-funding billionaire that wants to try to buy this seat. So I am asking you to please have my back today:

body:
Peter Willis, did you see
Larry Cohen's message about the urgency of our work to push Democrats to
take action and avoid a rightward turn ahead of 2024?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8497?t=1009&akid=4154%2E5885482%2EMFAGUj ]Read Larry’s message below, and pitch in here to help us close our
$46,421 budget gap before Friday's critical end-of-quarter deadline!

----Begin Forwarded Message---

Peter Willis,

In 2 days, Our Revolution will reach our
first end-of-quarter deadline of 2023, and with corporate power
consolidating control over both parties, the stakes are high.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8497?t=1010&akid=4154%2E5885482%2EMFAGUj ]Can I count on you to chip in to help close our $59,391 budget gap to
fund our critical work to take on the power of big money and restore a
democracy of the people in the United States?

As President Biden gears up for his re-election bid, we must make it clear
that to earn the trust and votes of young and progressive voters — he must
deliver for people and the planet. That means using executive action and
the bully pulpit to advance climate protections, worker rights, and more.

Instead, the President and Democratic leaders are moving in the opposite
direction - approving massive oil drilling projects in Alaska, breaking
rail strikes for paid sick leave, and siding with corporate elites
.
This doesn't just endanger our environment and economy, it directly
threatens our democracy by suppressing voter energy and giving right-wing
fascists a better chance to take back power in 2024.

That's why Our Revolution is working overtime to rally the progressive
movement to pressure the Democratic Party to pick a side and deliver now
for working people and the planet.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8497?t=1011&akid=4154%2E5885482%2EMFAGUj ]Can I count on you to pitch in to support this important work before
our first quarterly deadline of 2023?

If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to
Our Revolution will process immediately.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8499?refcode=EM_NBI_OR_20230330_FR_EOQ_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Larry&t=1016&akid=4154%2E5885482%2EMFAGUj ]CHIP IN $250 NOW » [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8496?refcode=EM_NBI_OR_20230330_FR_EOQ_0_6MO_OurRevolution_NA_NA_Larry&t=1017&akid=4154%2E5885482%2EMFAGUj ]CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT »

Right now, President Biden and national Democratic House and Senate
majority leaders Hakeem Jeffries and Chuck Schumer ALL need to be
challenged on their commitment to real change versus slick messaging.

We can’t let Democrats reverse course on climate, sit on the sidelines
when it comes to labor, and generally start tacking to the right ahead of
the next election instead of delivering results now while they have the
power.

We have a moment right now where we must prove to the American people that
this is a party of democracy that takes action and stands in stark
contrast to an extremist Republican Party. If Democrats are going to win
in 2024,our progressive movement needs to ramp up the pressure now.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/8497?t=1018&akid=4154%2E5885482%2EMFAGUj ]That’s why we need your help to fight back. Can I count on you to
pitch in before our first quarterly deadline of 2023?

When we organize, we win.

Larry Cohen
Board Chair

[](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=a66e8865d7&e=8c8e704ee6)
Peter,
The Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee (DLCC) has announced its plan to take control of the New Hampshire State Legislature and enact a radical agenda that threatens our liberty.

**They aim to turn the Granite State into their “East Coast California”** – a state where the government has an ever-expanding role in our lives and law-abiding citizens are disarmed.

Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire takes threats to our freedom very seriously, and we are fighting back by raising funds and helping elect legislators who will take The Pledge and uphold their promises to the people of New Hampshire.
[](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=8027c431a9&e=8c8e704ee6)
| [CHIP IN $25 OR MORE TODAY TO HELP US SECURE LIBERTY IN NEW HAMPSHIRE >>>](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=619235368a&e=8c8e704ee6)
---
Our current Pledge champions are fighting to reduce taxes, limit the role of government in our lives, and protect our “Live Free or Die State.”

The DLCC plans to make an early investment in New Hampshire to take control of the legislature, and we must do everything we can to stop them. If we don't act now, their radical agenda will be realized in the 2023-2024 election cycle.
[**Can we count on your support, Peter?**](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=17fff7bb0e&e=8c8e704ee6)

There are several bills in Congress attempting to ban TikTok – which we fully understand. Yet we cannot allow our focus on protecting ourselves from malign influence to blind us to others’ attempts to establish new powers for centralized government that can be wielded against us. As we fight to defeat the Chinese Communist Party’s influence, we must do what Tucker Carlson said the other night and speak up when “the solution has nothing to do with the problem.” As legislation catches up with the modern era, we quickly will have to learn how to balance our natural rights – in this case free speech, free assembly, and property rights – with the reality that some software may be a social media platform even as it can also be a weapon used to spy on Americans and strengthen our country's adversaries. These are debates that are worthy of discussion and serious consideration, and they must be handled properly. Unfortunately, so far, none of the current bills have struck that proper balance. **Furthermore, one bill in particular, the RESTRICT Act, is unconstitutional and, we fear, like the Patriot Act, would be abused and used against American citizens.** The RESTRICT Act is not only far too broad and vague in defining “foreign threats” but it leaves the interpretation of what constitutes a “foreign threat” to the executive branch, with no congressional input. In other words, the RESTRICT Act would give the Biden administration the power to attack its political enemies by designating U.S. citizens as having a shared interest with a foreign adversary, and then deciding on the punishment – including freezing financial assets, disrupting their businesses, or sending them to prison – without any input from the Congress. After you watch the videos in the links below and read the research, if the following Senators are yours, **please call the United States Capitol switchboard TODAY (3/20) at (202) 224-3121, ask for you Senator, and ask them to withdraw their sponsorship of the RESTRICT Act.**

My reply is to him and to all of you: We cannot turn our back on the Deep State even for a minute. The Deep State is relentless in its quest to accumulate more power. # First Three Episodes Posted!
---
Earlier this month, Dr. Vikram Mansharamani launched a radio show and podcast in partnership with The Pulse of New Hampshire. The show is called "Navigating Uncertainty" and weekly episodes will be released every Thursday via Apple Podcast, Spotify and everywhere podcasts are generally available!
(Several links below).
---
Here's a short description of the show:
Navigating Uncertainty is a show in which acclaimed global trend-watcher and futurist Vikram Mansharamani dives into how leaders make decisions. Through long-form conversations that move beyond sound-bites, Dr. Mansharamani explores how some of the most successful people think about tough choices. Serious, irreverent, entertaining, heart-warming, and occasionally tear-jerking, Navigating Uncertainty offers listeners bite-sized authentic biographies of high-impact leaders from all walks of life.

---
EPISODE 1: MIKE ROGERS
In the first episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Mike Rogers, former chair of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, and former multi-term Congressman from Michigan. Mike served in the military and also fought organized crime as a member of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. He's a class act, a first-rate thinker, and a patriotic American who cares deeply about the United States and its future.

---
EPISODE 2: GENERAL LORI ROBINSON
In the second episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with General Lori Robinson, USAF (Ret), a New Hampshire native who served as the Commander of North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD). General Robinson was also America's first female Combatant Commander and served as head of Northern Command. She is an awesome leader, dedicated America who has served the United States for decades, and all around amazing person. She has also faced (and successfully navigated) many forms of uncertainty on her path to becoming a four-star general.
---
|
EPISODE 3: VIVEK RAMASWAMY
In episode three, Dr. Mansahramani speaks with entrepreneur, one-time stand up comic, and prolific author Vivek Ramaswamy about the American dream and what it was like growing up in Ohio. In addition to exploring the power of annoyance, they discuss the key decisions that took Vivek from the Ivy League to a very successful biotech company (with a stint as a comedian along the way)...and his recent announcement to enter the US Presidential contest as part of his quest to help restore an American identity.

body:
You probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you’d make your first online contribution to Giffords PAC
#

Friends -
When you woke up this morning, you probably didn’t think you’d be making your first online contribution to Giffords PAC.
But we’re asking you if you can do just that.
**If you know already that you’re able to give today, you can use this link to make a contribution:**
[**https://go.giffords.org/go/March-EOQ-2023**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar23.q3bw9s&refcode=em230330-1-30&t=1&akid=4828%2E3935704%2EUscN0E)
If you need a little more explanation as to why your contribution today is so important, allow us to give you some reasons.
Tomorrow, we’re facing our first quarterly fundraising deadline of the year. Right now, we’re falling a bit short of where we’d like to be. At important deadlines like these, it’s really critical that we meet our goals.
The gun lobby may be losing some of their influence, but their hold on many extreme politicians remains strong. Many right-wing politicians choose to not act on gun violence out of fear of backlash from the gun lobby.
But that fear is **_nothing**_ in comparison to what a child must feel when a shooter enters their school, raining bullets down on them and their classmates. It’s nothing in comparison to what a parent who is waiting to be reunited with their child after a mass shooting event must feel.
Far too many families in our country have experienced this fear—most recently earlier this week after the tragedy at Covenant School in Nashville.
We have to raise a lot to help elect new leaders and take away the NRA’s power. That’s why meeting our fundraising goals—especially at quarterly deadlines like the one we’re facing tomorrow—is so crucial.
We know you may not have woken up today thinking you’d contribute $3 to Giffords PAC. But we hope now we’ve convinced you that today is the perfect day to do so.
[**So please. Use this link to contribute today before our quarterly fundraising drive ends tomorrow, March 31st at midnight.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar23.q3bw9s&refcode=em230330-1-30&t=2&akid=4828%2E3935704%2EUscN0E)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_
**[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://go.giffords.org/go/17015?c0=giffords-em-mar23.x28Ypi&amount=3&refcode=em230330-1-30&t=3&akid=4828%2E3935704%2EUscN0E)**
Thank you so much for your support,
The team at Giffords PAC

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=4&akid=4828%2E3935704%2EUscN0E) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

body:
We’ll explain why every day counts right now in our fight against bad information.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=786%2E120351%2EzndrgI)
Peter —
Tomorrow night, we’re facing our first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of 2023... but the truth is that our donations have slowed way down.
**We’ll explain why every day counts right now in our fight against bad information — but if you’re already on board to help us close our fundraising gap, chip in at this link:**
[**secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230330**](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/3559?refcode=em-20230330&t=2&akid=786%2E120351%2EzndrgI)
**FIRST,** **Trump is ramping up his lies in the face of a potential indictment**. At his recent rally in Waco, Texas, Trump was a spigot of misinformation, and clips spread like wildfire across social media.
[](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/3559?refcode=em-20230330&t=3&akid=786%2E120351%2EzndrgI)
**NEXT, more and more candidates have launched their 2024 campaigns in recent weeks** — meaning the next electoral cycle of political misinformation is already in full swing.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
Join us May 5th and 6th in Kennewick for the Republican Action Conference!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

**President Trump needs our help right now!**
Just moments ago, the NY Grand Jury indicted **President Trump**.
**Our nation is in trouble!**
I believe we have to work, sacrifice and engage more than ever before.
We have to make sure that **President Trump** is elected for the _third time_ in 2024.
How do we do that?
The largest voting bloc in America is the **Evangelical Christian** voting bloc.
However, our voter turnout is dismal at best.
How do we fix that in 2024? We MUST mobilize Pastors to encourage their congregations to **get out and vote**.
I am convinced if we can mobilize enough Pastors, we can increase the evangelical voter turnout which will **ensure a Trump victory** in 2024, which in all reality is a victory for America and the world.
As the leader of Pastor's For Trump, I am asking for youyr help to empower us to reach and equip more Pastors across the country.
It is time for Pastors to enage in the war that our nation is in.
Pastor's For Trump helps educate and equip Pastors to enage in the fight but we need your help to reach more Pastors.

| | Friends, We have a rapidly approaching fundraising deadline, and I need your support! My election victory in 2021 was one of the closest in the Commonwealth, with only 112 votes separating me from my opponent. Winning my race gave Republicans 51 seats in the House of Delegates – the majority! Every dollar was critical to helping me win. Now I am running for re-election to the House of Delegates and again, my election WILL determine the majority in Richmond. Working with my Republican colleagues as the majority party, we voted to improve our schools, make our communities safer, lower taxes and make our economy more prosperous. Education: Republicans worked together to put parents back at the center of their children’s education and promoted legislation that ensures children in Virginia receive the best education. I introduced Fairness in Women’s Sports, a bill to prohibit biological boys/men from competing in the girls/women categories in our schools. Public Safety: Our legislation this year included efforts to keep some of the dangerous felons from early release, give our local law enforcement agencies more tools to get dangerous criminals off the street, and keep those who commit multiple crimes of violence with firearms behind bars longer. Economy: The House supported changes to our corporate tax structure which would have provided much needed relief to small businesses across the Commonwealth. Inflation has impacted all our citizens, and we worked to keep more money in Virginians’ pockets by reducing the individual income tax and finally getting sales tax off food. I am so glad I won the 51st seat which gave the House a Republican majority, but I also enjoyed my own successes this year. Just this week the Governor signed three of my bills into law! I was honored to be chosen to represent Virginia Beach, and I am working hard to help my constituents and make the best decisions for the Commonwealth. We are currently close to our fundraising goal for the quarter, but we need your help! I am humbly asking for you to chip in and help defend this seat! Your contribution of $51 will allow me to be to remain as the 51st vote in Richmond. Will you help us reach our fundraising goal! Thank you for your support, Karen Greenhalgh

With only two days before the first end-of-quarter deadline this year, the Democratic National Committee is relying on support from folks like you to hit their fundraising goal and help win campaigns in every state, territory, and D.C. Without your support, the party won’t be able to fully invest in winning strategies like on-the-ground organizing, voter protection hotlines and litigation, and getting our message out to voters early and often. So, I’m asking: The Republicans are not waiting until next year to raise and spend money, Derek. They want to take back the Senate and hold onto the House in 2024 -- and they won’t waste a minute getting started. Neither can we. I know being asked for a donation in March of 2023 seems a little premature, but quarterly deadlines like the one tomorrow will lay the groundwork for Democrats’ success in 2024. Early investment pays off exponentially. A donation now is worth more than one in the final weeks. There are no off years at the DNC -- and that mentality has delivered some of the most transformative policies we’ve ever seen. The American Rescue Plan. The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. Hi everyone —

It’s Eve Schiff.

Yes, Adam and Eve. And yes, we’ve heard all the jokes. Yes, that one, too.

But I’m reaching out today with something serious:

Adam’s first deadline with the FEC (that’s the Federal Election
Commission) is tomorrow at midnight. And he needs your support — right
now.

Here’s a personal link: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2023_abs_em.pVOgM2&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20230330_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=2032%2E5257348%2ESGKIdq ]secure.actblue.com/donate/mar2023_abs_em

We have all watched Adam over the last six years. The work he’s done has
been so important.

We watched as he investigated Trump. We watched as he led the impeachment
trial against him. We watched his work on holding people accountable for
January 6th. And we saw how he was ruthlessly attacked.

By Trump. By Fox News. By Republicans like Kevin McCarthy and Matt Gaetz
in Congress. He is pretty tough, and has weathered the storm well, but
I’ll admit it — the viciousness of what he has endured concerns me.

That’s why Adam’s FEC deadline tomorrow — his first since launching this
Senate campaign — is such a serious one.

He is taking on a new challenge, and one that has already drawn new
attacks. From Trump at CPAC. From Tucker Carlson any night of the week on
Fox News. From their legions of hyper-online MAGA supporters. And on it
goes.

But if Adam is successful in overcoming these attacks and winning this
Senate seat, it will also allow him to be an even more powerful defender
of our democracy and its institutions. Because this isn’t about any of the
people attacking him. This is about the vision Adam has for the future of
our state and country, and the vision that I know you share. Where right
and truth and decency matter. And the oath of office means something.

Where the economy works for everyone, and everyone has a chance to
succeed. Where parents can put their children to bed knowing they will be
safe, knowing that if they get ill, they can get the care that they need,
and knowing that the planet can be as healthy as they are.

I believe that our country is filled with promise, and that our democracy
is precious. And fragile. Adam has been on the frontlines, protecting it.
He always will be. And you have always been by his side. I am so grateful
for that.

As Adam faces this critical deadline, I hope you will give him a huge show
of support today to help reach his goal. It would mean so much to me.
After all, we’re all in this fight together.
