subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc4j3su8doep6856cuafbi6bskne1dlqhcq9dp08_rp22sh2s8i66o70c9i60o34clh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zf226h2iehug0t23gqug5n6137sht7d2n7h22l50_rp22sh2s8i66o70c9i60o34clh2bs) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfi15muh5vc6jb7igl66fh9tn8fjqna8prdcqnt8_rp22sh2s8i66o70c9i60o34clh2bs) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection. By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below: For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty. This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;" Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. DeSantis has flip-flopped on U.S. intervention in Ukraine in [a recent interview with Piers Morgan](http://email.deskofdonaldjtrump.com/c/eJw9Tk1vhSAQ_DV6wyAg6oFDrenFtNf2ugo86cOPAIa8_vrCS9Nkszs7u5kZJWre4brnrO5LKRqia1waQTChmFJct7gjtOolMD13nPdULhx3BcNS-fuh5bGDld_BXdtZLcdWroI1s2aw4LnmLYMGS71oNvdY0lnrZm5KK9YQTl_Ql4K8pYoxVmFVtwucNLBnmcReHu0q-oRyljQ2cHnJ0B07Sv6wB-PRdXdgdoUiOOQu7w2goJwz4XAGLJLGn1dQpRPyjMZa43mb4t82MPaZGLbTGv0QRTsUhKxGJk_yDEcmNnx98OlzGtHw_mPRyBsW85W8ph4ep_p__VOpVNbNbDv-At1Ca1g) , where he called Putin a “war criminal” who should be “held accountable.”

Calling Russia a “gas station with a bunch of nuclear weapons” — or calling Putin [a] QUOTE “authoritarian gas station attendant with some legacy of nuclear weapons from the old Soviet Union” — is exactly the kind of simple-minded thinking that has produced decades of failed diplomacy and ultimately, war. Where is that war going?

Those such as Mitt Romney and Ron DeSantis — very much alike — who insist on arrogantly treating Russia as deeply inferior to the other nations of the world, with no history or culture or pride, are not only ignorant and foolish, but their attitude makes it impossible to negotiate peace. Absolutely impossible.

Under my administration, we were tough on Russia — tougher than any administration before — but we also demonstrated RESPECT for Russia and the Russian people. We demonstrated understanding for Russian history, and the fact that Russia lost over 20 million lives in World War II. They were fighting with us.

This kind of neo-con rhetoric, mocking Russia’s nuclear weapons, along with implying that Putin must be tried and presumably executed as a WAR CRIMINAL, only increases the chance of deadly nuclear escalation. Fundamentally, it shows a lack of depth, a lack of seriousness, and a lack of sophistication on the subtleties and complexities of foreign policy. You can’t do certain things and end up with peace.

This is not the time for on-the-job training as we face the possibility of nuclear war. And our leaders, if you call them that, got us there. This is where we are. The word “nuclear” was never even mentioned during the Trump Administration.

Now it’s being mentioned every hour of every day. We need a statesman and a peacemaker in the White House, not someone who recites mindless and recycled talking points to win the approval of the failed foreign policy establishment. They didn’t know what they were doing. In 2024, I am the only candidate who can prevent World War III. I will prevent World War III — there’s nobody else that’s going to do that.

Thank you very much.

body:
I chose not to accept corporate PAC contributions because my sole priority is fighting for you and your family, not wealthy special interest groups. | Dear Fellow American,

Our members have helped Judicial Watch take _an historic leadership role_ in forcing states to follow federal election laws that are our _last line of_ _defense_ against voter fraud and corrupt elections.
But the fact is that honest elections in America are under attack from the Biden administration and the radical Left, _who are on a long-term campaign to destroy our election safeguards_..._and make it easier to steal elections_!
That's a bold statement I know, but I promise you, it's no exaggeration.
**[And it is because the Left is pushing so hard on so many fronts to corrupt our elections that I ask you to give your support to Judicial Watch with a special gift today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=62774&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=4e8fb4f1996d836b232439a0732a01e77f5882481b006feb5fcfef9be385e9ed)**

Since 2012, we've been filing lawsuits and winning victories in federal courts in states including **California, Florida, Indiana, Kentucky, North Carolina** and **Ohio** to preserve honest elections, which is so important _to preserving our constitutional republic in this time of crisis_.

I am proud of Judicial Watch's unique and essential work keeping our elections clean and honest, and _helping make certain that only eligible American citizens are allowed to vote_.

Looking ahead to a presidential election in 2024, you can be sure we are tightly focused on fighting back against the Left's _radical and reckless measures like_...
* Unsecured mail-in ballots using (often highly) inaccurate voter rolls

* Ballot harvesting

* Abolition of voter ID requirements

Our work is vitally important...and [it is _expensive_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=62774&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=4e8fb4f1996d836b232439a0732a01e77f5882481b006feb5fcfef9be385e9ed).

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=62774&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=4e8fb4f1996d836b232439a0732a01e77f5882481b006feb5fcfef9be385e9ed)

Suing state governments, with their deep pockets and big legal budgets, is not only costly...it is time consuming. From start to finish, our election law litigation can take years. We always strive to squeeze the most out of our funds because we know that it is careful spending that keeps our clean election mission intact. _That 's very important_.

But we rely on the financial support of our most loyal and committed members like you to carry forward all our work.

Thanks to the commitment of our supporters, we will always find ways to confront corrupt politicians in both parties and Deep State bureaucrats who have contempt for the rule of law...especially our election laws.

[Your decision to to join with us today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=62774&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=4e8fb4f1996d836b232439a0732a01e77f5882481b006feb5fcfef9be385e9ed) will make it easier for us to respond with full force to challenges to the rule of law we are facing today... _especially the radical Left 's efforts to subvert honest elections._

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=62774&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=4e8fb4f1996d836b232439a0732a01e77f5882481b006feb5fcfef9be385e9ed)
---

We are the national leader in protecting the integrity of our elections. And you have my personal pledge that with your renewed support, we will _continue_ to be the most effective independent and effective government watchdog in Washington.

**Your special gift today will also help us expose public corruption, fight for the people 's right to know and hold lawless politicians and unscrupulous public officials of both political parties accountable.**

You can be assured that your tax-deductible gift at this time will help advance all our investigative, educational and legal activities. _[So please donate today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=62774&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX3Rlcm09TWF5&hash=4e8fb4f1996d836b232439a0732a01e77f5882481b006feb5fcfef9be385e9ed)_.

| | My friend, I'm going to let you in on a little political fundraising inside baseball... Peter, At a time when the American people are more noisily divided than ever before on a polarizing array of issues and causes, none of those issues is more divisive – or crying more for solutions – than the question of guns. We are all horrified by the toll of gun violence we are seeing across America. It’s hard to even fathom that we have had 17 mass shootings already this year. As a nation, these tragedies have united us in shock and mourning, yet the first talk of solutions tears us apart. Neither side is willing to put aside their rock-ribbed, pre-loaded position on guns in order to sit down and find the common ground for solutions. I am convinced that there are a number of reforms both sides can agree on, but it won’t be easy. As governor, I pulled together reasonable people on both sides of the issue – and those in between – and they found some common ground. Unfortunately, we weren’t able to get these reforms through our Legislature, and instead had to focus on how we could make some positive change through executive orders. From my experience, I believe what it will take to get politicians to act is for Americans to march in their communities and drive change from the bottom up – just as we saw during the civil rights movement. In the wake of another tragic school shooting, [I spoke with NBC's Andrea Mitchell](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=8fe64192f3914608b7d99705f842a590&_e=OTYPRXP8bSOIvo6bLiYi-pSKdtNpBBFGT-XZ7FPxdDhvpbffKWPosIlePUd1ebNskWn2EYGOIpKp9Bwjs7nx5EPGgO8mCx17wieJKLUEAT6Lbck0kp5_8MSvm_UpwgHE10jtfZGD9kR8GdP3FRmVuvaQyaSa3pHZvyZx95YoaL6Hfy64kH9Pau1BlJOM6WxUTwfUbs4-KHeHvc1driQnQGzPvNYl5LXnGGCyTLlwYW3Db-V_-fsw1BXkU_ZI_Kdv) about this on Tuesday:

clean_body: As a nation, these tragedies have united us in shock and mourning, yet the first talk of solutions tears us apart.| | | Peter, At a time when the American people are more noisily divided than ever before on a polarizing array of issues and causes, none of those issues is more divisive – or crying more for solutions – than the question of guns. We are all horrified by the toll of gun violence we are seeing across America. It’s hard to even fathom that we have had 17 mass shootings already this year. As a nation, these tragedies have united us in shock and mourning, yet the first talk of solutions tears us apart. Neither side is willing to put aside their rock-ribbed, pre-loaded position on guns in order to sit down and find the common ground for solutions. I am convinced that there are a number of reforms both sides can agree on, but it won’t be easy. As governor, I pulled together reasonable people on both sides of the issue – and those in between – and they found some common ground. Unfortunately, we weren’t able to get these reforms through our Legislature, and instead had to focus on how we could make some positive change through executive orders. From my experience, I believe what it will take to get politicians to act is for Americans to march in their communities and drive change from the bottom up – just as we saw during the civil rights movement. In the wake of another tragic school shooting, about this on Tuesday: Together, we can fight for positive change and save lives. I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. Thank you! -John | | | Get the Latest Updates: | | | | ---|---|---|--- | | | | Paid for by Kasich for America, not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.JohnKasich.com

And those radical election deniers haven’t gone anywhere. In fact, some of them are currently serving in the statehouse. With our democracy still under attack, _**it’s critical that we have a strongly Democratic Supreme Court to act as a firewall**_ against any bogus conspiracy claims they’re sure to make in the upcoming 2024 presidential election. This month, a Trump-appointed federal judge is likely to rule to restrict access to mifepristone, the abortion pill used in more than 50% of abortions. Fellow Democrats, today marks an historic moment in the fight for justice and the rule of law in our country.

Former President Donald Trump was just indicted on charges related to the cover-up of his "hush money" payments made in the lead-up to the 2016 election.

Michael Cohen, Trump's former lawyer and "fixer," **pled guilty in 2018** to committing campaign finance violations in arranging these payments, admitted he did so on Trump's behalf, and has already served prison time for these crimes.

No one is above the law.

It's high time the investigation into the allegations against Trump is brought to fruition. Trump has tried to discredit attempts to hold him accountable, tried to intimidate prosecutors, and has encouraged his grassroots supporters and GOP officials to take to the streets to protest.

No one is above the law.

**[Fellow Democrats, it is absolutely vital to our democracy and the rule of law that criminals be held accountable, especially when their crimes help elevate them to positions of power over our nation. Team Fetterman announced our goal, and we have to come to you to ask:
#
Hey Derek, our end-of-quarter deadline is coming up -- and it’s the first fundraising deadline of 2023.
Team Fetterman already announced our goal: **Raising another $50,000 by 11:59 PM on March 31.**
So we have to ask: **[Can you step up to the plate and be one of the donors that we need from 18326? We need as many people to help us reach our $50,000 goal by midnight on Friday.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230330-1?refcode=em20230330-1-8311&refcode2=8311_434096_nhLTHe&akid=8311%2E434096%2EnhLTHe)**

Derek, we’re in this together. Folks all over the Commonwealth chipped in what they could to elect John in November -- and now we’re supporting him in the fight for working families in the U.S. Senate.
And since John doesn't take a single cent from corporate PACs, the only way we’ll reach our $50,000 goal by March 31 is with your help.
**[If just a few more people from 18326 chip in, we’ll be able to reach our goal and start 2023 strong. Will you make a contribution today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230330-1?refcode=em20230330-1-8311&refcode2=8311_434096_nhLTHe&akid=8311%2E434096%2EnhLTHe)**

Team Fetterman 💛

Team, our first FEC fundraising deadline of the year is tomorrow, and we haven’t yet reached our fundraising goal. **[If you know you’re with us, I’d love it if you could pitch in $20, or any amount that works for you, before the deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/60983727/398853573/1342890860?refcode=email_033023_eoq2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjFiZDBlOC0zMGNmLWVkMTEtYThlMC0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OqCvPMyNwO7I0C3rrGiN0-HWUDqoG2DZRrcVI9RkD5w=)** But if you need more context before you consider donating, I completely understand — which is why I’m reaching out with this email. (I know it’s a bit long, but I hope you’ll take a moment to read it!) Listen, we all know there are too many elected officials who view winning elections as the end goal. But for me, the true end goal has always been to get things done for our community — for the regular Coloradans whose needs so often go overlooked in the halls of power. When I was a State Senator and Coloradans were struggling with the high cost of health insurance, **I helped pass a law that saved families thousands on their premiums.** When our students and teachers weren’t getting the resources they needed, **I helped significantly increase public school funding to support our kids and teachers.** And when the Supreme Court was poised to overturn Roe v. Wade, **I worked with my colleagues to pass legislation codifying abortion rights into Colorado law.** Now that I have the honor of serving in Congress, I’m working as hard as I possibly can to protect our rights and expand economic opportunity for families across our nation. Derek -- Tomorrow, the Democratic Party faces our next big test: the first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of the year. _And the funds we raise in these early days of the election cycle could determine what Democrats can accomplish in 2023, 2024, and beyond._ **The DNC provides crucial resources to Democrats running for office nationwide: on-the-ground organizing efforts to turn out voters, programs to protect voters, data and technology to reach voters, and so much more.** All of that depends on grassroots support. ---
| | Derek,

We are working hard to expand our Fiscally Conservative Majorities in Concord, [but the groups ideologically aligned with us need your help.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fexpand-majorities/2/010001873412206e-c13ce0cf-46ea-493d-8ee6-9f9e18b011f6-000000/QRbRsqL0CssHDVk4ze2wowirmA4=315)

---
| [Your donation through this new page will be split evenly between Granite Solutions, the Committee to Elect House Republicans, and the New Hampshire Senate Republicans.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fexpand-majorities/4/010001873412206e-c13ce0cf-46ea-493d-8ee6-9f9e18b011f6-000000/J9I705doVIc2kuukWmmGChz_E5Y=315)

**That means your donation means that much more:****
**_**
**_[_**33% to support efforts to elect more House Republicans.
33% to support efforts to elect more Senate Republicans.
**_**_33% to support efforts supporting fiscal conservatives across New Hampshire to state and municipal offices._**](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fexpand-majorities/5/010001873412206e-c13ce0cf-46ea-493d-8ee6-9f9e18b011f6-000000/oA_OBP5_AYil2AvISryvYmrTWKY=315)

Election season will be here before we know it and we need all the resources we can to fight against the Democrats' big money machine while ensuring our candidates and campaigns have the support they need in order to win.

The real way to fight back against the Democrat money machine? [By building our own.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fexpand-majorities/6/010001873412206e-c13ce0cf-46ea-493d-8ee6-9f9e18b011f6-000000/Tc6oEiWyrhEUUmSnKvrLjA_ELaQ=315)

When a Conservative gets upset, they go to Facebook and they share their opinion with the world and their 50 friends on Facebook get to see it.

When a Liberal gets upset, they go to ActBlue and donate $5 to their 5 favorite candidates and causes and help empower their coalition to be successful electorally.

So today, fellow Conservatives, I'm asking you to do two things:

[1\. Donate $5, $10, $25, or even $50 today to our new conduit page and help grow the Republican small dollar machine.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fexpand-majorities/7/010001873412206e-c13ce0cf-46ea-493d-8ee6-9f9e18b011f6-000000/VVbAVPvO0BnspJ4cXg09-6Vz2lY=315)

[2\. Share this page with your friends and family on social media and ask them to contribute to the cause as well.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fgranitesolutions%2Fexpand-majorities/8/010001873412206e-c13ce0cf-46ea-493d-8ee6-9f9e18b011f6-000000/h4T6o0Ow-cCSe6zGSM16-6RRbAk=315)

With one donation you can help Republicans expand their majorities in the State House while also building up a support network for fiscally conservative candidates and causes at the local level.

Best,

Rep. Joe Sweeney
Chairman, Granite Solutions

body:
It's time our energy infrastructure plans accounted for climate
| | [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-biden-you-have-power-to-account-for-climate/?utm_source=ema_2023-03-30_CEQ_climate_test_&source=ema_2023-03-30_CEQ_climate_test_&t=2&akid=13304%2E53494%2Er4KUdC)
---
Friend,
Massive fossil fuel projects have no place in our clean energy transition. Yet, earlier this month, the Biden administration approved ConocoPhillips' Willow Project, citing legal concerns as the primary justification.
Well, we can give President Biden a tool to help stop the next Willow—and every other climate pollution mega-project that needs federal environmental review. **It's called the climate test, and it would give government agencies a clear red flag if a major energy infrastructure project is incompatible with a 1.5 degree Celsius climate future.**
Right now, the Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ) has an opportunity to embed a climate test into federal agencies' environmental review processes. **The only problem? CEQ's guidance isn't strong enough to meet the urgency of the climate crisis.** [_**We have less than two weeks to urge CEQ to include the strongest possible version of a climate test. Send a pre-filled comment right now to ensure a safer climate future!**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-biden-you-have-power-to-account-for-climate/?utm_source=ema_2023-03-30_CEQ_climate_test_&source=ema_2023-03-30_CEQ_climate_test_&t=3&akid=13304%2E53494%2Er4KUdC)
[SIGN ON NOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-biden-you-have-power-to-account-for-climate/?utm_source=ema_2023-03-30_CEQ_climate_test_&source=ema_2023-03-30_CEQ_climate_test_&t=4&akid=13304%2E53494%2Er4KUdC)
---
A strong climate test will mean that all federal agencies will be encouraged to use the same science-based standard and keep us on track to meet our climate and policy commitments. Your input can mean the difference between the status quo or a future where the Biden administration is better equipped and empowered to reject fossil fuel projects.
**It's a no-brainer—the energy infrastructure we build should support our climate goals, not undermine them.[_Thank you for using your voice to ensure the cost of our future energy projects takes into account the cost to our climate._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-biden-you-have-power-to-account-for-climate/?utm_source=ema_2023-03-30_CEQ_climate_test_&source=ema_2023-03-30_CEQ_climate_test_&t=5&akid=13304%2E53494%2Er4KUdC)**

name: Cori Bush
subject: I'm sick and tired of this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Cori Bush for Congress
body:
#
I'm going to be blunt with you, Peter.
**I'm sick and tired of watching Republicans and Conservative Democrats trample on the legislation our communities urgently need.**
When you've lived out of a car with your small children, _you know that affordable housing isn't just a nice idea, it's a human right._
When you've seen your community lose their lives to police violence, you know that we need transformative change that radically redefines public safety, _while answering an urgent all to save Black lives._
When you've been forced to decide between affording groceries and utilities — when you've been forced to eat expired food from the shelves of a food pantry — _you know that the "handouts" Republicans keep attacking are life-saving for families._
These are the struggles that so many of us have lived. These struggles are why I ran for office and why I'm working every day to create a new kind of politics rooted in love and compassion.
But the challenges we face right now in Congress — from the Jim Crow filibuster, to the dark money funding too many of our elected officials' campaigns — have made it clear that **it's going to take a widespread, grassroots effort to bring these transformative policies to life.**
[**If you're with me in this movement, will you chip in $5 or anything you can so we can continue growing our progressive movement and pass the change our communities need?**](https://act.coribush.org/go/238?c0=cori-em-20230330.zTIxlG&refcode=em20230330-2418&t=1&akid=2418%2E1082990%2ELhxWAd)
**[Donate](https://act.coribush.org/go/238?c0=cori-em-20230330.zTIxlG&refcode=em20230330-2418&t=20&akid=2418%2E1082990%2ELhxWAd)**
When you love all of humanity, you care that everyone is housed. You care that everyone is fed. You care that everyone is safe. You care that everyone has health care. You care that everyone has an education.
**This is what I'm striving for.** It seems like common sense — but dark money, white supremacy, disinformation, and our broken political system have made this vision, a divisive one.
**The challenges we face are immense. But I know that when we work together, we have the power to move mountains.**
Even just in our second term in Congress, we're tackling issues like racial justice and health care — **all because of folks like you, Peter.**
You are part of a larger people-powered movement that's gaining momentum and transforming the way we do politics. Together, we are making progress and demanding the change we deserve.
That's why today I'm asking for a favor: I'm going to keep working for policies that lift ALL of us up, but I can't do this alone. I need your support as we organize and legislate in Congress for an agenda that puts people first. **[If you can afford it, will you chip in $5 or anything you can to help us continue doing this work? We have an important fundraising deadline tomorrow at midnight, and you could help us reach this goal.](https://act.coribush.org/go/238?c0=cori-em-20230330.zTIxlG&refcode=em20230330-2418&t=21&akid=2418%2E1082990%2ELhxWAd)**
Thank you for all of your support.
Your Congresswoman loves you,
Cori

**[Contribute ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cori-em-20230330?refcode=em20230330-2418-footer&t=22&refcode2=2418_1082990_LhxWAd&akid=2418%2E1082990%2ELhxWAd) **

body:
We’re doing this because the future is not something to experience, it’s something to manifest.

Hey everybody, it’s Gavin Newsom.
I wanted you to be the first to know that earlier today I started a Political Action Committee that is called The Campaign for Democracy.
As someone who supported some of my work and campaigns previously, if that’s all you need to hear, I am asking if you can help me get started with a donation today.
Here’s a link to donate:
[**https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/CampaignforDemocracy**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cfd-em-mar-23?refcode=em230330-1-500k&refcode2=1196_4767699_T7s4_t&akid=1196%2E4767699%2ET7s4_t)

Here’s the truth:
America is in an existential struggle for democracy.
Across the country, extremist Republicans are systematically attacking the very foundations of our free society.
They've silenced speech, fired teachers, kidnapped migrants, subjugated women and attacked the Special Olympics.
They've made it harder to vote and easier to buy assault weapons.
They've sold fear and panic when it comes to crime, but calm and indifference when the threat is greenhouse gasses destroying our planet.
They've fanned the flames of culture war to distract from the fact that blue states have lower murder rates, better education and health care outcomes, and higher GDPs.
My PAC, the Campaign for Democracy, will tell the truth.
We are going to go on the road and on offense — in red states too — and take the fight to statehouses, local communities, and electoral battlegrounds to save our democracy. We’re going to help folks like President Biden at the top of the ticket and down the ballot.
You’ve seen me do it with TV ads in Florida going after Ron DeSantis’ assault on “Freedom.”
You’ve seen me do it in states like Indiana, Mississippi, Ohio, South Carolina, South Dakota and Texas — offering help to the women of those states who have been persecuted when seeking an abortion.
And you’ll see me do it a lot more in the near future.
People may ask, why are you doing this?
We’re doing this because democracy, patriotism, and the values we all care about are on the line.
We’re doing this because the future is not something to experience, it’s something to manifest.
So I am asking for your help. We all have a responsibility to do something in this moment, no matter our role in life.
And if you think taking the fight to Republicans on what true freedom means – and doing it on their turf – is worth doing, please chip in:
[**Use this link to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today, to my Campaign for Democracy PAC. It’d mean a lot to me if you’d become a Founding Donor of this work.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cfd-em-mar-23?refcode=em230330-1-500k&refcode2=1196_4767699_T7s4_t&akid=1196%2E4767699%2ET7s4_t)

I wanted you to be the first to know that earlier today I started a Political Action Committee that is called The Campaign for Democracy. As someone who supported some of my work and campaigns previously, if that’s all you need to hear, I am asking if you can help me get started with a donation today. Here’s a link to donate: Here’s the truth: America is in an existential struggle for democracy. Across the country, extremist Republicans are systematically attacking the very foundations of our free society. They've silenced speech, fired teachers, kidnapped migrants, subjugated women and attacked the Special Olympics. They've made it harder to vote and easier to buy assault weapons. They've sold fear and panic when it comes to crime, but calm and indifference when the threat is greenhouse gasses destroying our planet. They've fanned the flames of culture war to distract from the fact that blue states have lower murder rates, better education and health care outcomes, and higher GDPs. My PAC, the Campaign for Democracy, will tell the truth. We are going to go on the road and on offense — in red states too — and take the fight to statehouses, local communities, and electoral battlegrounds to save our democracy. subject: Petition: Help Stop Major Threat HB 2659 and Support Climate-Friendly and Equitable Communities
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Oregon League of Conservation Voters
body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/60996128/398868474/697470913?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDQwMWI5LTNiY2YtZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CkL_pNPFYGmHPe3VqgPCB3LPcf9gELDCIFkWaUt4Vdw=&emci=9a447973-24cf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=b44401b9-3bcf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=2107230) | | | Hello Peter, A Major Threat bill, HB 2659, is scheduled for a public hearing next Tuesday. The bill would repeal and delay our newly adopted Climate-Friendly and Equitable Communities (CFEC) program, rolling back the progress we’ve made on tackling climate change and addressing inequity. We should be providing the CFEC program with adequate funding. Instead, [**we find ourselves fighting for its right to exist. Will you make your voice heard and add your name to this petition that we are submitting as public testimony on April 4th?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/60996131/398868475/-1609798450?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDQwMWI5LTNiY2YtZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CkL_pNPFYGmHPe3VqgPCB3LPcf9gELDCIFkWaUt4Vdw=&emci=9a447973-24cf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=b44401b9-3bcf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=2107230) The CFEC program, which was part of the major climate executive order signed by Governor Brown, would transform eight urban areas in our state by making neighborhoods more pedestrian and bike friendly, improving air quality, and improving liveability for everyone. This program is a critical piece of Oregon’s Climate Action Plan. [**It can help make our communities healthier, more inclusive, and more climate-resilient for generations to come.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/60996134/398868478/-1609798450?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDQwMWI5LTNiY2YtZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CkL_pNPFYGmHPe3VqgPCB3LPcf9gELDCIFkWaUt4Vdw=&emci=9a447973-24cf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=b44401b9-3bcf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=2107230) Extreme heat threatens our communities and environment, and it’ll only get worse unless we act to decrease climate pollution. Our state is getting hotter and drier. Temperatures are rising, disrupting rainfall patterns and creating more frequent drought conditions, as well as more extreme weather events. Overall, warm and dry conditions are likely to increase with climate change and are associated with large wildfires in our state––like the 2020 Labor Day fires. Climate change affects our agriculture and timber industries and fisheries. It also affects our daily lives. Whether your favorite hobbies include skiing, fishing, or simply exploring your neighborhood, we enjoy our open spaces year-round. [**By prioritizing our environment, climate, and housing when developing our cities, the CFEC program aims to reduce climate pollution and provide more affordable housing options.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/60996136/398868480/-1609798450?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDQwMWI5LTNiY2YtZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CkL_pNPFYGmHPe3VqgPCB3LPcf9gELDCIFkWaUt4Vdw=&emci=9a447973-24cf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=b44401b9-3bcf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=2107230) Last year, over 1,600 individuals, businesses, and organizations spoke up to help ensure that our state adopted the program. We need to make this transition. **A rollback of this program would most likely mean a continuation of the status quo: continued dependence on and prioritization of gas guzzling modes of transportation, inequitable access to housing options, and extreme weather conditions.**[**That’s why we need your help to stop this bill from gutting the CFEC program. We need more affordable housing options in walkable, transit-friendly neighborhoods. Can you sign on to this petition before next Tuesday?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/60996138/398868482/-1609798450?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI0NDQwMWI5LTNiY2YtZWQxMS1hOGUwLTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CkL_pNPFYGmHPe3VqgPCB3LPcf9gELDCIFkWaUt4Vdw=&emci=9a447973-24cf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&emdi=b44401b9-3bcf-ed11-a8e0-00224832e811&ceid=2107230) Thank you for your support, Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV | |

name: AOC, Ayanna, Cori, Ilhan, Jamaal, and Rashida
subject: A message from the Squad Victory Fund
body:
We’ll need all the support we can get if we want to keep advancing life-changing policies in Congress.
#
Friends — AOC, Ayanna, Cori, Ilhan, Jamaal and Rashida here!
If you haven’t already heard, all six of us are gearing up to meet a very important deadline at the end of the month. The Federal Elections Committee (FEC) first quarter fundraising deadline is _this Friday_ , and we’re hoping to reach our goal of raising an additional $25,000 before the clock strikes midnight.
Reaching this goal, for the first time as a newly expanded Squad, would show our opposition the true strength of our movement — and make clear that we aren’t going anywhere. But we can’t do this without you.
If you’re ready to join in on the action and support our Squad right now, please consider making a donation of any amount to help us close the gap on our goal and kick off Q2 in the strongest position possible.
**We’ve even provided you with your very own personal link so you can make your donation as soon as possible:**
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/svfem-march-deadline?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=svfem-march-deadline.7siRpp&refcode=io-em230330-2-svf-30&t=1&akid=44%2E791427%2E9iqDTL)**
We’ve grown so much since our Squad first got to Congress in 2018. And we know that, with you on our side supporting each and every one of us, we’ll be able to accomplish even more in the future.
But the truth is, we need to ensure we have the resources, tools, and funding to keep pace with our collective vision. And we’ll need all the support we can get if we want to keep advancing life-changing policies in Congress.
The full strength of our Squad is undeniable. And our opposition knows it — that’s why they’re gearing up to throw everything they have into unseating us and diminishing our progressive power. **Let’s make sure that doesn’t happen.**
A contribution from you today — before our end-of-quarter deadline — will help boost our campaign resources, show the true strength of our movement, and keep us on the path to victory. **So, if you stand with us, please use the personal link below to make a contribution to our movement today.**
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/svfem-march-deadline?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=svfem-march-deadline.7siRpp&refcode=io-em230330-2-svf-30&t=2&akid=44%2E791427%2E9iqDTL)**
Thank you for your continued belief in the work we’re doing together. Without you, none of this would be possible.
Together,
Alexandria, Ayanna, Cori, Ilhan, Jamaal, and Rashida

Paid for by The Squad Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, Rooted in Community Leadership PAC, Cori Bush for Congress, and Bowman for Congress.
The Squad Victory Fund
c/o Mele Brengarth & Associates LLC
PO Box 15845
Washington, DC 20003
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can **[unsubscribe here](https://act.ilhanomar.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?source=em-footer&t=3&akid=44%2E791427%2E9iqDTL)**. You can also **[sign up to receive fewer emails](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/fewer-emails/?source=em-footer&t=4&akid=44%2E791427%2E9iqDTL)**.
Submit this form to [**update your contact information**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/update-contact-info/source=em-footer?t=5&akid=44%2E791427%2E9iqDTL)
In addition to what’s legally required, The Squad Victory Fund does not accept contributions from: (1) corporations, associations, or their PACs; (2) individuals registered as federal lobbyists or under FARA; (3) from the PACs, lobbyists, or SEC-named executives of fossil fuel companies; or (4) from the Fraternal Order of Police.

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated as follows: 10% to each of Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, Rooted in Community Leadership PAC, Cori Bush for Congress, and Jamaal Bowman for Congress.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Cori Bush for Congress, and Jamaal Bowman for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

To contribute via check, please address to The Squad Victory Fund c/o MBA Consulting Group, PO Box 15845, Washington D.C., 20003

Email us: [**info@squadvictoryfund.com**](mailto:info@squadvictoryfund.com)

Peter, We’re excited to have you on Team Wilson! Shawn laid out why this election is so crucial to our future, and we’ll need a strong team to win. In 30 hours, we have our first End of Quarter deadline of the year. | | | | [ ](https://nyc.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ebb7fcc9c4e1e9fab452c873&id=c915294c20&e=2de202398d)
---
| Peter --

The last few weeks have been hard. We've waited for the former President to potentially be indicted in criminal court. We've watched as people -- children -- have lost their lives to gun violence and mass shootings. We've been subjected to disgusting attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, trans rights, and reproductive rights. And we've done all of it while continuing to live through a pandemic and the climate crisis.

But through it all, I'm still hopeful -- and that's all because of you. [**In 30 hours, we have our first End of Quarter deadline of the year -- and I'm hoping you'll chip in to help me finish strong and keep our movement moving forward toward a better future.**](https://nyc.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ebb7fcc9c4e1e9fab452c873&id=77d8d08a69&e=2de202398d)

I've watched as our movement has stood together over the last six years to create a first-in-the-nation municipally funded abortion fund in order to make and keep New York a national abortion haven, and to fund the transgender navigator program to ensure trans and gender nonconforming New Yorkers have an easier time accessing the care they need. I've stood alongside you as we've fought car congestion by building more bike lanes and investing in the MTA. And I've been alongside you as we mourn every life lost to gun violence by fighting harder to ban weapons of war from our streets to keep each other safe in honor of those we couldn't.

[**Can I count on you to chip in any amount before midnight tomorrow to keep me -- and us all -- in this fight?**](https://nyc.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ebb7fcc9c4e1e9fab452c873&id=3fba6ce168&e=2de202398d)

| Thank you for inspiring me daily,
Carlina

name: LCV Rapid Response
subject: DEVELOPING... House passes dirty energy bill H.R.1 in 225-204 vote
body:
Time sensitive

Peter - our Membership Drive deadline is a few days away, and we're reaching out because we haven't heard from you yet (renew your membership here and your contribution will be tripled https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fbDxgvS~ ).

The truth is your membership matters, and it's particularly critical right now.

Here's the situation: Earlier this month, Senator Joe Manchin backed away from a climate deal after months of negotiations, choosing to side with Big Oil and Republicans. It leaves the deal one vote short -- stalling any real action in Congress for now.

In response, we're redoubling our efforts on pushing the White House to act decisively on climate. The Biden administration has massive amounts of power to curb climate pollution - but that will only happen if the environmental movement makes it happen.

Right now, we're facing a critical test: the Biden administration is weighing a plan to block all new oil and gas drilling leases on public waters.

This could be huge -- and a decision is coming. Right now, we're organizing volunteers from all over the country to flood the administration with letters, pressuring Biden to hold to his promises.

Peter -- it's your membership support that makes victory possible here. But we have to do more. A group of donors has put together a fund to triple match every contribution before Sunday's membership deadline:

Can we count on your support? Claim your membership now - it only takes $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/w_

The ban on new oil and gas leases is the first of many huge environmental decisions, Peter. And right now, we're pushing for serious action on so many fronts -- including:
Setting tight standards for power plants and other major emitters of climate pollution
Placing strict limits on air pollution to safeguard all communities Expediting requirements of 100% tailpipe pollution-free new cars by 2035 and trucks by 2040
Protecting communities from hazardous and super-polluting methane Conserving 30% of our public lands and waters by 2030 Declaring a climate emergency - and so much more. The best way you can help win each and every one of these fights right now is to claim your LCV membership - all it takes is a gift of $5 or more. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, Peter. This is such a critical moment for the environment, and we're so fortunate to have you on the team.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters

| | Peter, I recently introduced a bill to **_finally_** address the insidious Zuckerbucks that ran rampant in our last election. _"Our thoughts are with the families, the victims, with the community. We are grateful for the quick, rapid response of law enforcement, and I think with respect to any discussion of legislation, it's premature.”_

How can action on gun violence be “premature” when gun violence is the **number one** cause of death for children in America?
How can action on gun violence be premature when tens of thousands of people die from senseless acts of gun violence each year?
How can action on gun violence be premature when there have been 130 mass shootings in America just this year alone?
The gun lobby’s stranglehold on a handful of radical politicians is strong, and we need to fight back. We must elect leaders who will fight our nation’s gun violence epidemic with real legislation and action, not those who will sit back and bow down to the gun lobby.

A phrase I love to use: “reclaiming your time”
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=20304%2E3422442%2Ev6-pu4)
As a former professor, I know when people are stalling because they don’t have the answer to a question. So when witnesses do this during congressional hearings, there’s a phrase I love to use: _reclaiming my time._
Now, I know I email you these long messages, and you might be thinking—get to the point. [**So in the interest of reclaiming your time, here are the quick(!) answers to why I’m asking for your $5 today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230330-2?refcode=EMAF30_2_YOU_20230330_V1_F&refcode2=20304_3422442_v6-pu4&akid=20304%2E3422442%2Ev6-pu4)
**Q: Why are you the right candidate to represent California in the U.S. Senate?** A: We need someone to fight the battles of tomorrow, stand up to special interests, and “do Congress” in a way that connects with Americans—many of whom are disillusioned with our government. I’ve spent my career taking on some of the most powerful corporations and delivering for working people, and I’m ready to take our fight to the Senate.
---
**Q: What’s the advantage of giving *today* rather than next week?** A: Tomorrow is the final day of the quarter, and that means we’ll soon be required to report how much we’ve raised since our campaign launched. Reporting a strong number can deter future attacks and proves that we don’t need corporate PACs or lobbyists to run a winning campaign.
---
**Q: How do my donations get used?** A: Right now your donations help us put on events, hire staff, and lay the groundwork for our campaign. But we also begin saving and planning ahead for our substantial ad buys. Another candidate jumped into this race with three times the cash we had, so we know we need to catch up.
---
[**Derek, I’d be so appreciative of any donation you can make before tomorrow at midnight.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230330-2?refcode=EMAF30_2_YOU_20230330_V1_F&refcode2=20304_3422442_v6-pu4&akid=20304%2E3422442%2Ev6-pu4)
**[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230330-2?refcode=EMAF30_2_YOU_20230330_V1_F&refcode2=20304_3422442_v6-pu4&akid=20304%2E3422442%2Ev6-pu4)**
Thanks a ton!
Katie

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAF30_2_YOU_20230330_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=20304_3422442_v6-pu4&akid=20304%2E3422442%2Ev6-pu4)**

A: We need someone to fight the battles of tomorrow, stand up to special interests, and “do Congress” in a way that connects with Americans—many of whom are disillusioned with our government. I’ve spent my career taking on some of the most powerful corporations and delivering for working people, and I’m ready to take our fight to the Senate. Q: What’s the advantage of giving today rather than next week? A: Tomorrow is the final day of the quarter, and that means we’ll soon be required to report how much we’ve raised since our campaign launched. Reporting a strong number can deter future attacks and proves that we don’t need corporate PACs or lobbyists to run a winning campaign. Q: How do my donations get used? A: Right now your donations help us put on events, hire staff, and lay the groundwork for our campaign. But we also begin saving and planning ahead for our substantial ad buys. Another candidate jumped into this race with three times the cash we had, so we know we need to catch up. Thanks a ton! Katie Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma.

body:
We can’t sit by and watch as more and more people fall victim to senseless violence.
#
Friend,
Six people, three of whom were children, lost their lives on Monday when a shooter carrying an AR-15 targeted a private Christian elementary school. My heart aches for their families, and for the Nashville community as a whole, in the wake of this horrific tragedy.
This week’s mass shooting in Nashville is just the latest example of the epidemic of gun violence plaguing our country. The United States has suffered at least [130 mass shootings](https://act.rokhanna.com/go/11318?t=8&akid=2672%2E946728%2EVqas3o) in 2023 alone.
We can’t sit by and watch as more and more people fall victim to senseless violence. [**Sign if you agree: It’s time to ban assault weapons.**](https://act.rokhanna.com/go/11319?t=9&akid=2672%2E946728%2EVqas3o)
Until 2004, when the 1994 ban on assault weapons lapsed without Congressional action, a person’s likelihood of being killed in a mass shooting in the United States was 70 percent less than it is today. These weapons are responsible for [25 percent of deaths and over 75 percent of injuries](https://act.rokhanna.com/go/11320?t=10&akid=2672%2E946728%2EVqas3o) in mass shootings, and they are capable of shooting five times as many people as guns without high-capacity magazines.
There is no justification for allowing Americans to purchase assault weapons. It’s imperative that we enact a ban on assault weapons before countless more people lose their lives.
[**Sign the petition: Tell Congress to pass an assault weapons ban.**](https://act.rokhanna.com/go/11319?t=11&akid=2672%2E946728%2EVqas3o)
In solidarity,
Ro

Fellow American, Candace Owens here – and I’ve got exciting news. **BLEXIT -- the nonprofit I founded to free minorities from the Left’s victimhood mentality, or “plantation of the mind” -- is joining Turning Point USA!** Alongside my friend Charlie Kirk, the Turning Point USA team, and grassroots patriots like you, I am ready to: _Defeat_ toxic and racist Leftist ideologies like Critical Race Theory – getting them out of our kids’ classrooms forever, _Free_ black Americans and all minorities from the tyranny of the Left's victimhood mentality and inspire them to pursue their American Dreams, and _Win_ against the radical Left as Turning Point USA goes toe-to-toe with fake news media, toxic pop culture, biased “educators,” Big Tech, and more! [**To accomplish these massive – and important goals – I must raise $100,000 as soon as possible. Can I count on your support of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3a45cbb4ee9e43a9bc069b63e8fa7064&_e=inpermY_5vOyZAkHCJRIGVFI0E__3zaSQBFBFQJKpSx69riPoXW4xJDuhm8_zlu63bhvjHjVn4VhxevhrVbr5wUBHKF-85L99YptXTg6PXs04CSBOaVlMeiRKCst5qC0AGxb4ijitdYn_RYA7Ls6Bj_1unCYBHE-xJjXkmft258vDmlT2sVHckZpkQhBLju3MGnHFGukqzClGRY3qlb7-w0_9ikNqz3nacMd4Lclh40eZDymkLOKpZCA-ox6FYD0XRlWxwT1vqp6HmnDF-8T1KfiQNOB-jcI5USzmruoAxk%3D)
---
[**Stand with Candace and Turning Point USA**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3a45cbb4ee9e43a9bc069b63e8fa7064&_e=inpermY_5vOyZAkHCJRIGVFI0E__3zaSQBFBFQJKpSx69riPoXW4xJDuhm8_zlu63bhvjHjVn4VhxevhrVbr5wUBHKF-85L99YptXTg6PXs04CSBOaVlMeiRKCst5qC0AGxb4ijitdYn_RYA7Ls6Bg4mN_pYhtEPiifmb9rl7ry7RcqgAQ00SyM5FeYkLB-eu4xoSnOV-s9ZImWn7SUzU88hinAMfOA6Ed5OYZhycecp16yFTnINRLSpJfj_qB1ZNXy1UEUqUEIhbAg21JV7nrlR7MZ7bg0iToG5gGchEM0%3D)
---
When the BLEXIT team and I decided that it was time for us to offer _even more_ life-changing programs ... expose _even more_ of the Left’s toxic and racist lies ... and reach _even more_ minorities with our inspiring message about the American Dream, I thought of my friend Charlie Kirk and Turning Point USA right away. That’s because, in the fight to save America from the Left, Turning Point USA is the real deal – organizing 600,000+ student activists to FIGHT and WIN today’s Culture War. **But to hit the ground running in this exciting new partnership, I must raise $100,000 as soon as possible.** [**Will you stand alongside me, my friend Charlie Kirk, Turning Point USA, and TPUSA's BLEXIT programs by making your gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3a45cbb4ee9e43a9bc069b63e8fa7064&_e=inpermY_5vOyZAkHCJRIGVFI0E__3zaSQBFBFQJKpSx69riPoXW4xJDuhm8_zlu63bhvjHjVn4VhxevhrVbr5wUBHKF-85L99YptXTg6PXs04CSBOaVlMeiRKCst5qC0AGxb4ijitdYn_RYA7Ls6BmliVtKxbDh3TFfRfasVrGu_7jxPNZm9PMuLaFK9f1fg8attxY0mjGbzw5wjIVkNodnYdX4NcnpzsDotQTf2_rbEleMFcx82FivOO6rCiLrKapWaAUndpFKii7oor23M3_nPJTfT6GFBs6q7YK74-pA%3D)
---
[**Stand with Candace and Turning Point USA**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3a45cbb4ee9e43a9bc069b63e8fa7064&_e=inpermY_5vOyZAkHCJRIGVFI0E__3zaSQBFBFQJKpSx69riPoXW4xJDuhm8_zlu63bhvjHjVn4VhxevhrVbr5wUBHKF-85L99YptXTg6PXs04CSBOaVlMeiRKCst5qC0AGxb4ijitdYn_RYA7Ls6BuV8aROnhbwWCWkClQwaXRxkdgBJ86B650I7Zz7KX_xD2t7-SUnpg9ij_6MzgLCc27h_K0bOlD_8ZRSUL3IphbJETWuXytlOfMLTOPG2Mn9txkJA0X1gkE_CUDPgTtdRZ-xFN2E3b6fwj96wK2qa948%3D)
---
In 2018, I founded BLEXIT to inspire Black Americans to turn away from the victimhood mentality and to reject the Left’s new “plantation” of the mind. Now, in 2023, I’m proud to have BLEXIT work alongside Turning Point USA to expose _even more_ of the Left’s toxic and racist lies and reach _even more_ Americans with TPUSA’s inspiring, pro-America message – that teaches every American to love our country again, work hard, and pursue their American Dream! [**Today I’m counting on your help to hit the ground running. Will you please make your most generous gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more today to help me reach our critical $100,000 goal?**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3a45cbb4ee9e43a9bc069b63e8fa7064&_e=inpermY_5vOyZAkHCJRIGVFI0E__3zaSQBFBFQJKpSx69riPoXW4xJDuhm8_zlu63bhvjHjVn4VhxevhrVbr5wUBHKF-85L99YptXTg6PXs04CSBOaVlMeiRKCst5qC0AGxb4ijitdYn_RYA7Ls6BmLyuU4qRMHi7tuL-24Bep6Kzh57NbdDggCfAgsMToeA8V8mWREAXEAu3yQ-vLwQKSZdxNyuz4nflOsCxLrObNCPiwcOTYlmjfmgZIAt_98VHOOgctkBUEMTlySasl5ObiuPM00g0V_2UGtTWGC5JH8%3D)
---
[**Stand with Candace and Turning Point USA**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3a45cbb4ee9e43a9bc069b63e8fa7064&_e=inpermY_5vOyZAkHCJRIGVFI0E__3zaSQBFBFQJKpSx69riPoXW4xJDuhm8_zlu63bhvjHjVn4VhxevhrVbr5wUBHKF-85L99YptXTg6PXs04CSBOaVlMeiRKCst5qC0AGxb4ijitdYn_RYA7Ls6BhEkOeMoXohALdhp-qi-FOAN5l8bX0TlNVkiMZgcqQSug6jntJc1fp03hXCET6wwBE5gJW6_Elg5ujqgoKqK6j9fpmIv7DT02YKZqmyZnvvXfBa4uS2saCDYd3BAk6FtoaZ_c1nM7jLz6iddgIM406s%3D)
---
Working together with Turning Point USA, BLEXIT will inspire MILLIONS more young people from all backgrounds to escape the Left’s “Woke” dystopia and to love America once more. [**If you're with me, please make your gift right now.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=3a45cbb4ee9e43a9bc069b63e8fa7064&_e=inpermY_5vOyZAkHCJRIGVFI0E__3zaSQBFBFQJKpSx69riPoXW4xJDuhm8_zlu63bhvjHjVn4VhxevhrVbr5wUBHKF-85L99YptXTg6PXs04CSBOaVlMeiRKCst5qC0AGxb4ijitdYn_RYA7Ls6BjgIpQUGxGerfx2IIzvgV1r7vdA2j1TxoRRcSU8vJySAXhF7DZmbFGFQ0hP6S4c8R8pXgs_T-GL1dIWDg5RbMISTjDd85Wa8I-P7p1dSPiJWrAFUeCfJJOtUOWDSdCtibzASh-sINh3ExbzUT98yaU5Buo0fRdHmV5UbhsFJEIrt) Time is running out -- I hope to hear from you today!

* Repealed the state's 1931 abortion ban as well as its sentencing guidelines
* Passed a law that would amend the Elliott-Larsen Civil Rights Act (ELCRA) and codify into law protections against discrimination based on gender identity or sexual orientation
* Expanded workers' rights and passed the Lowering MI Costs Plan that puts money back in the pockets of Michiganders

On the other hand, in GOP-led Legislatures across the country:
* Wyoming banned the abortion pill

* Florida is allowing citizens to carry firearms without a permit

To say the partnership between Florida Governor Ron DeSantis and the Harper Collins publishing company is _a queer relationship_ would be an understatement.
It turns out, if you're Ron DeSantis, you don't go broke when you go woke!
Investigations by this reporter into the book deal of Governor Ron DeSantis has revealed that the Florida Governor, who bills himself as the biggest culture warrior and parental rights champion in the State of Florida, is making millions of dollars in the form of book sales from Harper Collins publishing company, which profits from selling and promoting LGBTQ and other woke books that Governor DeSantis's administration has supported banning in the state of Florida. Or so he says...
As I have previously reported, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis launched his new book, _" The Courage to be Free: Florida's Blueprint For America's Revival" _on February 28th, 2023 through a [book deal with Harper Collins,](https://substack.com/redirect/562f3e2b-a554-45a1-aa2e-1b330f15a571?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a publishing company owned by Rupert Murdoch's media conglomerate, NewsCorp. The book deal is reported to be over $2 million, and is rumored to be closer to $8 million by sources within the publishing industry.
How did Governor DeSantis score a multi-million dollar book deal? Originally, his book deal was orchestrated for $2 million via Simon and Schuster. However, Rupert Murdoch, who owns News Corp and Fox News, reportedly poached the book deal from Simon and Schuster for his own company, Harper Collins, which is a subsidiary of News Corporation. Given that the deal with Simon and Schuster was already agreed upon, DeSantis, who needed to give the public an explanation regarding his change in publishing companies, claimed he pulled out of the deal with Simon and Schuster after realizing Simon and Schuster is owned by Paramount, which is the parent company of CBS News's _60 Minutes_.
Governor DeSantis has a longstanding feud and grudge against _60 Minutes_ because he claims they published false reports about his deployment of the COVID-19 vaccines in Florida. In you recall, Governor DeSantis took great pride in getting Floridians vaccinated, and hosted press conferences where he said he personally signed for the vaccines from Fed Ex. DeSantis has accused CBS of reporting that he only prioritized giving the first batches of the COVID vaccine to his donors, and Floridians who live in wealthy communities. DeSantis denies this accusation.
You may be wondering....ok, whats's the big deal if he switched publishing companies?
Well, what Governor DeSantis and Harper Collins don't want you to know is that as he continues to make millions from his partnership with Harper Collins off a book in which he brags about combatting corporate wokeism, restoring parental rights, and creating what he calls "curriculum transparency legislation" in Florida to "Guarantee parents the right to inspect the materials being used in their kids's schools" (introduction xviii), he recently signed a book deal with a company that is promoting and selling the very same LGBTQ books that Florida has removed from public schools under his Governorship!
This is an astounding act of hypocrisy from both Governor DeSantis and Harper Collins. DeSantis axed his original book deal with Simon and Schuster over what was described as conflicting political messages from their parent company. However, while he bloviates on Fox News (also owned by Rupert Murdoch and tied to Harper Collins) about how he's leading the fight in the culture war, what he's actually doing is enriching himself with a publishing company that is publishing the very same books he claims to be fighting to remove from public schools in Florida under the guise of "parental rights".
In the introduction of his book on page xviii, DeSantis writes,
> "Our mantra in Florida has been education, not indoctrination. Florida was one of the first states to enact a Parent's Bill of Rights, which enshrined into law substantive protections for the role parents play in education, as well as curriculum transparency legislation guaranteeing parents the right to inspect the materials being used in their kid's schools. **We prohibited the teaching of toxic racial ideologies and protected against the sexualization of children.** That these measures would even be necessary is proof of how far the modern school system has drifted from the core mission of education."
When DeSantis cracked down on books being taught in the Florida public school system, books which he argued are sexual and racist in nature, he received national blowback and was accused of "book banning" and "censorship". In his newly published book, as seen from the above excerpt, DeSantis is proud of his record of banning books and allowing for parents to help suggest which books and materials should be banned from the public school system.
**There is nothing wrong with parental rights. But, there is something wrong with political flip flopping for the sake of personal enrichment and deceiving the voters.**
Although Harper Collins has since deleted these images from the front page of their website, even though you can still find them on other pages, my investigation has uncovered that Harper Collins has an active campaign to combat state efforts that are banning books from public schools and libraries. Harper Collins feels so strongly about opposing book banning efforts akin to what DeSantis is promoting in the state of Florida, that they are featuring, promoting, and selling some of the most banned books in America on their official website.

In the introduction of his book on page xviii, DeSantis writes, "Our mantra in Florida has been education, not indoctrination. Florida was one of the first states to enact a Parent's Bill of Rights, which enshrined into law substantive protections for the role parents play in education, as well as curriculum transparency legislation guaranteeing parents the right to inspect the materials being used in their kid's schools. We prohibited the teaching of toxic racial ideologies and protected against the sexualization of children. That these measures would even be necessary is proof of how far the modern school system has drifted from the core mission of education." When DeSantis cracked down on books being taught in the Florida public school system, books which he argued are sexual and racist in nature, he received national blowback and was accused of "book banning" and "censorship". In his newly published book, as seen from the above excerpt, DeSantis is proud of his record of banning books and allowing for parents to help suggest which books and materials should be banned from the public school system. There is nothing wrong with parental rights. But, there is something wrong with political flip flopping for the sake of personal enrichment and deceiving the voters. Although Harper Collins has since deleted these images from the front page of their website, even though you can still find them on other pages, my investigation has uncovered that Harper Collins has an active campaign to combat state efforts that are banning books from public schools and libraries. Harper Collins feels so strongly about opposing book banning efforts akin to what DeSantis is promoting in the state of Florida, that they are featuring, promoting, and selling some of the most banned books in America on their official website. | | ---|---|--- On their website under a title that reads ", a list of some of the most popular banned books are listed, with hyperlinks directing readers where to buy the books. It was , and was hosted to counter claims made against the Governor and his decision to have certain books removed from schools. At the bottom of a blue and yellow graphic published by Governor DeSantis's office, titled, "Myths vs Facts: BOOK BAN HOAX", it reads, "FACT: Florida has taken a stand against pornography and sexual material in the classroom. HB 1557 and HB 1467 further solidify Florida's commitment to ensuring that content available in our schools is appropriate for students. has been in law for many years and carries a felony penalty for the distribution of pornographic material to children." | | ---|---|--- Underneath the video that was posted to Twitter by Taryn Fenske, who serves as the Executive Communications Director in the office for Governor DeSantis, Christina Pushaw, who served as the Rapid Response Director for Governor DeSantis's 2022 re-election campaign and has been reportedly helping DeSantis recruit influencers to support his 2024 Presidential campaign, tweeted, "Wow! Local news stations carrying press conference had to cut their feeds because the material was too inappropriate but it's okay for children to read it at school??? Sick." " The fact that this was published before Governor DeSantis signed his book deal with Harper Collins shows that DeSantis went through with the Harper Collins book deal even though Harper Collins is promoting, marketing, and making a massive profit off of various woke children's books, including sexually explicit LGBTQ books banned in the state of Florida at Governor DeSantis's request. | | ---|---|--- This is yet further evidence that Governor DeSantis's will talk a big talk, but he doesn't walk the walk...especially if it means hopping in bed with Rupert Murdoch's publishing company to sign a queer book deal. | | ---|---|--- In another statement on Harper Collins' website on a page dedicated to promoting and marketing banned LGBTQ children's books, , "HARPER COLLINS STANDS AGAINST CENSORSHIP Books harness the power of literature to develop empathy and understanding and should reflect the diversity pf the world we live in. Florida Governor Ron DeSantis has championed laws that have resulted in the censorship of everything from biographies of African-American historical figures to discussion of women’s periods from public schools. It’s creepy, wrong, and unfortunately spreading across the country. DeSantis hopes to ride his crusade against academic freedom all the way to the White House.

And that’s the issue. MAGA extremists didn’t start this culture war because they care about the curriculum our children are learning — this is part of a top-down political strategy.

I strongly believe in keeping partisanship out of our schools — and I would oppose attempts at censorship by the left as well as the right. So Districts for Democracy will work with and support all who uphold these principles, regardless of party.

[So,what do you say? I won because Massachusetts voters know it too. And even though we’ve been up against powerful forces, the past ten years have shown us that when we organize, fight righteous fights, and hold those in power accountable, we can make positive change, including:
* Getting student loan debt cancelation to President Biden’s desk
* Passing a new tax on massive corporate profits
* Lowering the cost of hearing aids
* Pressuring Wells Fargo executives into resigning after their fake accounts scandal
* Even making billionaires cry on national TV

BREAKING NEWS:

The Manhattan District Attorney’s office has indicted Donald Trump for
criminal offenses — the first-ever indictment of a former American
president.

It is a somber moment, and unprecedented for a former president to be
indicted, but his alleged offenses are also unprecedented. If the rule of
law is to be applied equally — and it must — it must apply to the powerful
as it applies to everyone else. To do otherwise is not a democracy.

Trump will respond as he always does — playing the victim and blaming
others for having the temerity to investigate him in the first place. And
you know that I will be one of the first people he will go after. He
always does.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=mar2023_abs_em.j7Sg7U&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20230330_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=2043%2E5257348%2EIl4QqW ]Rush $10 to my campaign right now to help us prepare for Trump’s
inevitable attacks — and ensure we defend the rule of law.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=mar2023_abs_em.j7Sg7U&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20230330_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=2043%2E5257348%2EIl4QqW ]DONATE $10

Derek — the Manhattan District Attorney just indicted Donald J.
Trump with criminal charges stemming from hush money payments he made to a
porn star during the 2016 campaign. It is the first of what may be several
charges resulting from criminal investigations in New York, Georgia, and
at the Justice Department.

The indictment of a former president is a very serious matter, but so is
the sweep of Donald Trump’s misconduct. And one thing that has always been
clear about Trump, if he is not held accountable, he will go on to commit
even worse offenses.

And let’s be absolutely clear:

Donald Trump is as dangerous as ever, trying to incite his followers to
protest his arrest — we saw where his last efforts at incitement brought
the country. We must make sure that never happens again.

And this may be just the beginning of the fight to hold him accountable —
with another grand jury investigation in Fulton County, Georgia, that is
still pending, and a federal criminal investigation as well.

Trump has accused Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg, who is Black,
of being a politically motivated “racist.”

He has called the grand jury inquiry a “witch hunt.”

There is no doubt Trump will weaponize this indictment for his political
advantage — just like he did with impeachment — because winning the
presidency may well be the only way he hopes to avoid going to jail.

Trump has shown that he will tear down the entire system of American
democracy to protect himself and return to power. And we must not let him.
Derek, rush any amount to our campaign right now.

This is seriously disturbing...

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!
